content.comment_body: How is it possible to use [product_name] with a TD display to handle 50 messages when only 27 flags are available? Since each message needs a separate flag or an output, and I prefer not to use outputs, advice would be appreciated. Any urgent solutions are welcome.
Hello. It is possible to connect all message texts to a single flag. If you are working with function block diagrams, you can use an OR function to group all message texts together.
Thank you for the clarification—it's clear once explained. Wishing you a good day!
Another approach is to use open connectors X for additional options.
Alternatively, you can connect messages directly to an output.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are discussing message flag limitations with [product_name] and a TD display, focusing on how the number of message texts exceeds the available flags. The conversation shows there is confusion about managing more messages than flags, but users have shared multiple workaround strategies. The expectation of one-to-one flag-message control does not align with the current design, prompting creative solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a simple way to link each message on the TD display to an individual flag, ideally ensuring a one-to-one correspondence between message texts and flags for easier management.
